fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set Risk warnings (01M6W4K4); no owner present. The planner read the intent (warn, never block, when an autonomous workflow with bypassPermissions can be triggered by outside input), health's autonomy part, workflow.check, request --ref, autonomyStage (rhiza.autonomy.*), rhiza.daemon.permissionMode, adapter Bypass, and the accepted Workflow dispatch change set. It raised four questions in one: which intent to serve, what counts as exposed, where health shows it, and whether to wait for Workflow dispatch. The arbiter answered with Decision risk-warnings-shape: serve the backlog milestone; every queued request is outside input (a schedule is a cron job running rhiza request, invisible to Rhiza); flag the request workflow (plan) when plan autonomy is auto and the ready workflow (ship-change) when plan and ship autonomy are both auto, when any agent, check or arbiter step's effective mode (its permission_mode, else rhiza.daemon.permissionMode) is a bypass mode per its adapter; workflow check warns without changing valid or the exit code; health puts it in the autonomy part as warn with one detail per workflow and Next rhiza guide workflows; do not wait for dispatch, compute the reached workflows in one function that whichever change set lands second makes read .rhiza/dispatch.toml. The planner then wrote five leaves.
fields.title: Risk warnings plan, autonomous run
